final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT d.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(*) AS disposition_count FROM disp AS d JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY d.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_sums AS (SELECT frequency, SUM(disposition_count) AS frequency_sum FROM account_counts GROUP BY frequency), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(frequency_sum) AS average_sum FROM frequency_sums) SELECT f.frequency, f.frequency_sum, f.frequency_sum - o.average_sum AS difference FROM frequency_sums AS f JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.average_sum IS NOT NULL WHERE f.frequency_sum > o.average_sum ORDER BY f.frequency
